summary: Short 15 m stub at a junction mouth, signed No Stopping Any Time.
reasons: No Stopping Any Time signs on it

drivers.seclusion: Houses sit about 15-25 m away, but the stub is a junction corner in view of the main road; no OSM buildings within range.
drivers.access_and_room: Small sealed side-street mouth with trees; one car parked there, but no clear room for a van clear of the corner.
drivers.traffic: Corner of a through street, steady local traffic.
drivers.convention: Three No Stopping Any Time signs, within 1 m and 6-7 m of the kerb line.

flags: No Stopping Any Time signs at the kerb
Too short to be a usable section
sun_shade: Mostly tree shade from the west and north-west; open to the east.
